sections.title: 4 · 下周展望
sections.body:
The compression is the story until a channel forces it open. Watch the policy path: a near coin-flip in September gives way to a hike bias by December, and neither the vol read nor the credit read is braced for it. If that conviction firms, the front end and equity vol are the two things mispriced against the curve, but on today's tape neither has moved. Foundry and Memory led the sector board hard while Cybersecurity and Software lagged — a risk-on rotation into the semi-capex chain rather than a defensive crouch, which sits oddly beside the tightening tilt. The el-nino-ag theme kept its excess. Into the 9/16 decision, the pinned dealer book keeps range tight; the trade is patience, not premium. Confirmation comes from credit widening or vol reasserting, not from the equity internals alone.
